ref.caption_en: A plain grating of straight stripes, one every 16.75 µm, turns the infrared pump into a broad second-harmonic beam at 790 nm: the measured output is a smooth bell curve, just as the simulation predicts.

output_waist_paper.source: main text, Fig. 4b(i); not reproduced by the deposited profile (1/e^2 half-width 108 um, see output_waist_fit); close to the SH waist at z_ref, 132/sqrt(2) = 93.3 um (SI Eq. S70)

output_waist_fit.source: computed: Gaussian 1/e^2 half-width of the Fig. 4b(i) profile (the model's output: 112 um)

peak.source: computed: notebook scaling of the profile to 408 nW in total

conditions.value: 60 fs, 100 MHz pulses; 6 mW on chip; bias 600 V; pump beam waist 132 um

focus.caption_en: Curving the stripes turns the grating into a lens: the second-harmonic light is focused onto the chip's output facet, into a spot with a waist of only 16 µm.

waist_s35.source: SI Sec. S10A, Fig. S35 (narrowest of the focus scan, lens.pkl)

waist_fit.source: computed: Gaussian fit to the Fig. 4b(ii) profile

q_opt.source: Fig. S35 / comb.pkl curvature 0.0075: 2 pi c / (Lambda dpx)

q_chirp.source: computed from comb.pkl chirp 2e-6 (confirmed in the stored patterns); the SI text prints 5.3e-7

conditions.value: 60 fs, 100 MHz pulses; 6 mW on chip; bias 600 V; pump beam waist 132 um

nine.caption_en: Overlaying several lens patterns, each shifted sideways by 52.8 µm, splits the light into as many spots: nine lenses give nine evenly spaced spots. The slider adds the lenses one by one.

offset_step.source: SI Fig. S36 caption (14 SLM pixels)

spot_spacing_n9.source: computed: mean spacing of the 9 measured peaks at the output

conditions.value: 60 fs, 100 MHz pulses; 6 mW on chip; bias 600 V; pump beam waist 132 um

airy.caption_en: Bending the stripes into a cubic curve makes an Airy beam, which resists spreading: a bright main lobe trailed by weaker side lobes. The paper shows c_Airy = 1.05 × 10⁻⁵ rad/µm³; the slider scans 21 settings.

c_airy_main.source: SI Sec. S10C: 1.05e-5, the case shown in Fig. 4b(iv) (index 8 of c3_list; the main text gives no value)

pattern_length.source: Airy.pkl: SLM columns 900-1099 around z_ref; the SI text says 7242 um

conditions.value: 60 fs, 100 MHz pulses; 6 mW on chip; bias 600 V; pump beam waist 132 um

steer.caption_en: Tilting the straight stripes steers the beam sideways: between −0.4 and +0.4 rad the output spot moves by about 245 µm, which places the output facet 1.58 cm from the start of the pattern.

displacement.source: computed: Gaussian centres at -0.4 / +0.4 rad (Fig. S34b)

L_out.source: Fig. S34 fit; SI Eq. (S71): 1.58e4 um
